There are always many people at the family kitchen. David hopes to visit London one day. David thinks math is interesting but a little difficult. What's more, mum baked cookies on the rainy afternoon.
David spent the weekend at the supermarket. Amy is interested in drawing. It takes twenty minutes to get to the vegetable market by bike. Black coffee tastes bitter.
Last Monday, David and Amy went to the vegetable market. David bought a sweater at the shop yesterday. The weather was sunny that day. In fact, dinner is ready.
Both of them like noodles and coffee. They took many photos at the family kitchen. David plays football with Amy every Monday.
